node.statement: Norm calculation. Apply compressed-product-display inside M_n tensor A to the compatible pair Z^dagger,Z from node 1.2.1: ||Z^dagger dot Z-Z^dagger Z||<=C_cp*e*||Z^dagger||||Z||=C_cp*e*||Z||^2, where dagger isometry is part of epsilon-banach-cstar-norm-axioms. Since A is extended epsilon-C*, the same registered axioms at level n give ||Z^dagger Z||>=(1-epsilon)||Z||^2. Reverse triangle inequality and 0<=epsilon<=e yield ||Z^dagger dot Z||>=(1-epsilon-C_cp*e)||Z||^2>=(1-(1+C_cp)*e)||Z||^2=(1-B*e)||Z||^2, proving node 1.2 uniformly in n.
